svg.title: tacet init and tacet status
svg.desc: A real tacet init run on a sample project, then tacet status listing four suggestions: move a 5-step release procedure into a skill, delete a directory tree, import AGENTS.md (which adds tokens) and turn off commit credit lines. Each waits for a yes in /tacet.

text.tspan: tacet init
tacet
dev
project /tmp/tacet-demo/shop
Every session here loads about
80 tokens
of your setup before you type, plus Claude Code's own prompt.
Plugin skipped (--no-plugin): hooks won't run until you install it.
4 suggestion(s) need a yes from you: type /tacet in Claude Code.
Done. tacet now works on its own. Restart Claude Code to load the plugin; type /tacet anytime.
tacet status
SUGGESTIONS
Move the 5-step Release procedure into skill release
a 5-step procedure ("Release") loads every session
tacet apply skill-release · tacet dismiss skill-release
Delete the directory tree at CLAUDE.md:6
a directory tree the agent can list itself
tacet apply tree-62b6cddd · tacet dismiss tree-62b6cddd
Import AGENTS.md from CLAUDE.md (adds its tokens to every session)
Claude Code skips AGENTS.md here because a CLAUDE file exists
tacet apply agents-bridge · tacet dismiss agents-bridge
Turn off commit and PR credit lines
Claude Code adds its own credit lines to commits and pull requests by default
tacet apply attribution-off · tacet dismiss attribution-off
